findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_mcp_server_trust · Private data: check_mcp_server_trust, review_agent_skill_free, manage_buyer_finops_spend_passport, audit_api_sla_escrow, audit_depin_gpu_sla_escrow, quote_multitoken_escrow, open_escrow_job, submit_encrypted_deliverable, claim_escrow_timeout_refund, audit_quant_backtest_escrow, audit_smart_contract_escrow, audit_agent_skill_escrow, audit_rag_embeddings_escrow, audit_ai_inference_escrow, purchase_firstparty_catalog_item, notarize_and_witness_a2a_deal · Public sink: check_mcp_server_trust, review_agent_skill_free, submit_encrypted_deliverable, register_and_certify_store, submit_veritas_tier_upgrade_exam.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_mcp_server_trust · Private data: check_mcp_server_trust, review_agent_skill_free, manage_buyer_finops_spend_passport, audit_api_sla_escrow, audit_depin_gpu_sla_escrow, quote_multitoken_escrow, open_escrow_job, submit_encrypted_deliverable, claim_escrow_timeout_refund, audit_quant_backtest_escrow, audit_smart_contract_escrow, audit_agent_skill_escrow, audit_rag_embeddings_escrow, audit_ai_inference_escrow, purchase_firstparty_catalog_item, notarize_and_witness_a2a_deal · Public sink: check_mcp_server_trust, review_agent_skill_free, submit_encrypted_deliverable, register_and_certify_store, submit_veritas_tier_upgrade_exam

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "manage_buyer_finops_spend_passport" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
